narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -7.44 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 0.3198-0.3293 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 0.3315; the first objective pays 0.44R at 0.3179.

plan.triggerRule: footprint sdiv fired sell in short direction at the zone (absorption inside the zone)
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 0.3315 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 0.48 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk

athena_oracle.verdict: Strong bearish confluence 26/100 — trend broken, flow fading, liq magnets below
